stops.name: Königsstuhl
stops.detail: The Königsstuhl is a chalk rock formation of the Stubbenkammer in the Jasmund National Park on the Baltic Sea island of Rügen.

stops.name: Nationalpark-Zentrum
stops.detail: From there, a shuttle bus runs year-round on a road closed to private traffic to the National Park Center.

stops.name: Hochuferweg Jasmund
stops.detail: Hikers reach the Königsstuhl via the approximately 12 km long Jasmund high bank path, which leads from Sassnitz to Lohme.

stops.name: Viktoriasicht
stops.detail: The Königsstuhl itself is better viewed from the Viktoriasicht located slightly to the south.
